messages:
Nia (People Ops): Short notice: auditors asked us to accelerate the SOC2/ISO artifact collection window. New hard cutoff: 2026-04-09 23:59 PDT. Please prioritize any outstanding uploads.
Kobe (Security): Essentials we need for production services: access control exports, recent infra configuration snapshots, and a short drift statement if configs changed in last 30 days.
Tess (Engineering): For infra snapshots, is a rendered console screenshot acceptable or do you prefer repo + commit?
Kobe (Security): Either is fine. Best practice: include repo + commit AND a screenshot, or an automated export path (S3/GCS) plus README.
Olga (Legal): Quick reminder to remove or redact customer PII before uploading. If youre unsure, send a redaction question to legal@redwood and well advise.
Nia (People Ops): Use the secure evidence form: <https://redwood-internal/forms/compliance-evidence|evidence form>. Add control IDs in the filename (e.g., IAM-05_roles.csv).
Tess (Engineering): Will managers need to attest? Where do we sign off?
Nia (People Ops): Managers should complete the attestation checkbox in the form. Were also asking for a one-line confirmation in the comments field.
collector-bot: Evidence ingestion job: nightly-run -> will flag missing metadata and expired links :mag_right:
Kobe (Security): If you provide automated outputs, include a short README explaining the script and cadence. Helps speed review.
Tess (Engineering): Uploaded: IAM-05, INF-09 (s3 paths included). Manager attestation done.
Olga (Legal): Thanks. Well spot-check and flag anything that needs redaction.
Nia (People Ops): Office hours tomorrow 10:30am and Friday 2pm in #people-ops-help for quick checks. If youd like an extension, request via the form with manager sign-off; well approve only for critical conflicts.
Tess (Engineering): Noted, will chase remaining items today.
Nia (People Ops): TL;DR: cutoff 2026-04-09 23:59 PDT, use the evidence form, manager attestation required, office hours tomorrow/Friday. Ping @Nia for help. :white_check_mark:
